recently_moved_to_uk: Whether the claimant has recently moved to the UK.
right_to_reside_status: A plain English description of the claimant's right-to-reside position.
eu_status: The claimant's EU Settlement Scheme status, where relevant.
apprenticeship_location: The country where the child has started an apprenticeship, where relevant.
informal_arrangement: Whether the claimant is looking after someone else's child through an informal arrangement.
claimant_dispute_unresolved: Whether two responsible claimants cannot agree who should claim Child Benefit.
is_adopting: Whether the claimant is adopting the child.
child_has_moved_in: Whether the child being adopted has come to live with the claimant.
hospital_abroad: Whether the child is in hospital abroad.
